ar.text: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ

en.text: We have reached the evening and the dominion belongs to Allah, and all praise is due to Allah

azkar.transliteration: Allahumma bika amsayna wa bika asbahna

en.text: O Allah, by Your leave we have reached the evening and by Your leave we reach the morning

ar.description: من قالها مئة مرة حطت عنه خطاياه

en.text: Glory be to Allah and all praise is due to Him
en.description: Whoever says it 100 times, his sins will be forgiven
